description: This is a BitBake recipe (.inc file) for the iproute2 package, which provides utilities for controlling TCP/IP networking and traffic control in Linux. It includes configuration, build, and installation instructions, as well as dependencies, package information, and file listings.

classes.name: bitbake recipe
classes.description: Defines build, configuration, and packaging instructions for the iproute2 utilities, including dependencies, source files, and output files.

methods.name: do_configure
methods.description: Configures the build environment by running the 'sh configure' script and disables ATM support via 'sed'.

methods.name: do_install
methods.description: Installs the built utilities into the destination directory, moves the 'ip' binary to a different name, and cleans up share files.
